name: the-italian-club-functions
description: Notifications that reach a phone with the app closed. The only code in this project that does not run on a phone.
//overrides: uuid is forced to the patched 11.1.1 for EVERY package that asks for it. Nothing here depends on uuid directly: it arrives three levels down under firebase-admin, and gaxios/google-gax/teeny-request each pin ^9, which is the range GHSA flags (missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when a buf is passed). Those three call ONLY uuid.v4() and pass no buf, so the flaw was never reachable here — this removes a standing alert, it does not close a hole. Upgrading firebase-admin does NOT help: the newest release still carries the same chain. Verified before shipping: all three libraries resolve 11.1.1, return valid v4 ids and load without error. Drop this override once Google's libraries stop asking for uuid 9.
